description: The file is a PHP unit test class for the FastRoute routing library, specifically testing the RouteCollector class's route adding and grouping functionalities.

classes.name: RouteCollectorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the route collection and grouping functionalities of the RouteCollector component in FastRoute.

classes.name: DummyRouteCollector
classes.description: A mock subclass of RouteCollector used within tests to record routes added during test execution.

methods.name: testShortcuts
methods.description: Test adding individual routes with various HTTP methods to the RouteCollector and verify the stored routes match expected.

methods.name: testGroups
methods.description: Test nested route group additions with prefixes and verify the resulting route list.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route with the specified method, route path, and handler to the collector, including current group prefix.
